[root@reve-otp ~]# cat /etc/asterisk/extensions_custom.conf
; ── BitsAuto: Cut vendor leg immediately ─────────────────────────────────────
[gov-hangup]
exten => s,1,Hangup()

; ── BitsAuto: OTP digit playback to customer ─────────────────────────────────
[otp-playback]
exten => s,1,Answer()
 same => n,Wait(1)
 same => n,Playback(custom/your_otp_is)
 same => n,SayDigits(${CALLERID(name)})
 same => n,Wait(1)
 same => n,SayDigits(${CALLERID(name)})
 same => n,Hangup()

; ── BitsAuto: Media recording anchor ─────────────────────────────────────────
[sippy-media-anchor]
exten => _2060X.,1,NoOp(BitsAuto Governance: product=${EXTEN:4:1} dest=${EXTEN:4} uid=${UNIQUEID})
 same => n,Set(GOV_PRODUCT=${EXTEN:4:1})
 same => n,MixMonitor(/var/spool/asterisk/monitor/${UNIQUEID}.wav,r)
 same => n,Dial(SIP/sippy/22211${EXTEN:4},3600,Tt)
 same => n,Hangup()

exten => _1.,1,NoOp(OTP call: ${EXTEN})
 same => n,Answer()
 same => n,StopMixMonitor()
 same => n,Goto(otp-playback,s,1)

exten => _X.,1,NoOp(Unhandled call in anchor: ${EXTEN})
 same => n,Hangup()

; ── BitsAuto: Post-cut playback to customer ──────────────────────────────────
[gov-playback]
exten => s,1,NoOp(Governance playback: ${GOV_PLAYBACK_FILE})
 same => n,StopMixMonitor()
 same => n,Wait(1)
 same => n,Playback(silence/1)
 same => n,Hangup()
